name: whatsapp_outbound_messages
description: Durable intent and dispatch evidence for one free-form WhatsApp reply.
lifecycle: Enqueued before dispatch. Retried only after an explicit provider throttle rejection and while the service window remains open. An unresolved attempt enters UNCERTAIN for reconciliation. Automated retention is release-plan work.

columns.Meaning: Caller-assigned immutable UUID for one reply intent and the opaque identifier echoed by Meta on delivery callbacks.
Meta business phone number ID that owns and sends the reply.
Immutable destination and validated text or interactive reply content.
Current queue, provider acceptance or delivery evidence state.
Last allowed dispatch deadline from the current inbound customer service window.
Earliest eligible time for the next dispatch attempt.
Most recent claim time used to detect an abandoned dispatch.
columns.Null meaning: The queue has not claimed this reply.

columns.Meaning: Number of claims recorded before making a provider request.
Meta message identifier returned on acceptance or on a correlated delivery callback.
columns.Null meaning: Provider acceptance or delivery has not supplied an identifier.

columns.Meaning: Integer Graph error code from an explicit rejection or delivery failure.
columns.Null meaning: The current evidence has no provider error code.

columns.Meaning: Provider timestamp of the accepted delivery status update.
columns.Null meaning: No delivery callback has advanced this reply.

columns.Meaning: Database timestamp when the reply intent was first enqueued.

constraints.Purpose: Rejects invalid negative dispatch attempt counts.
Prevents another reply intent with the same durable identifier.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX whatsapp_outbound_messages_dispatch_idx ON public.whatsapp_outbound_messages USING btree (business_phone_id, state, available_at)
constraints.Purpose: Supports finding due messages for a configured sender and tracking current states.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX whatsapp_outbound_messages_provider_key ON public.whatsapp_outbound_messages USING btree (business_phone_id, provider_message_id)
constraints.Purpose: Correlates delivery by provider message ID within one business phone number and prevents conflicting associations.
